instruction: On slide 14 of 45_1.pptx, set the first textbox to 60 pt bold and the second textbox to 28 pt.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly opens slide 14 via prs.slides[13] (0-indexed) and iterates shapes to find first two non-empty textboxes.
Font size extraction uses correct EMU-to-pt conversion: round(run.font.size / 12700).
Bold flag is extracted via run.font.bold, returning True/False/None as expected.
Metric correctly accesses expected keys directly (textbox1_size_pt, textbox1_bold, textbox2_size_pt), consistent with type='rule' framework where expected IS the rules dict.
All three task requirements are covered: textbox1 size (60pt), textbox1 bold (true), textbox2 size (28pt).
Partial credit scoring (0.4 + 0.2 + 0.4 = 1.0) is well-designed and semantically appropriate.
Metric correctly treats None bold as not-bold (line: if actual_bold is not True).
Expected values (60, true, 28) match the instruction requirements exactly.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: If font size or bold is stored at paragraph/textframe level (not run level) by LibreOffice, run.font.size/bold returns None. Consider falling back to para.runs[i].font or tf.paragraphs[0] paragraph-level properties when run-level size is None.

Shape iteration uses document XML order, not visual/spatial order. If textboxes are not in expected order in the XML, textbox1/textbox2 may be swapped. Consider verifying by inspecting textbox text content in the judgment.
